defaults.rollbackToGray: plugin.json lifecycleState active->gray after failed operational evidence or unresolved conflict
defaults.stateRationale: registered source, current consumer and operational fixtures are present
defaults.promotionCriteria: trigger precision requires real comparable work units; structural evidence alone cannot promote lifecycle state

consumer-validation-engineering.stateRationale: gray until independent cross-repository consumer evidence covers at least two contexts
consumer-validation-engineering.promotionCriteria: two independent repositories with fresh identity, artifact and CI evidence plus acceptable correction rate

rework-prevention-engineering.stateRationale: gray until prospective ReworkEffectivenessLoop evidence reaches its sample threshold
rework-prevention-engineering.promotionCriteria: prospective comparable work units demonstrate benefit, bounded false positives and a tested rollback path
